items.title: Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows for privilege escalation through the upload of malicious files to the server.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical improper output encoding vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) could lead to arbitrary code execution via targeted attacks through webhooks.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical Stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) allows for privilege escalation by injecting malicious scripts into the backend.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce (unauthenticated)
items.summary: An unauthenticated critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce (unauthenticated)
items.summary: This unauthenticated critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 8.2) allows for unauthorized access to resources, bypassing security features.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, enabling remote code execution via a specially crafted cookie.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could enable arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical Path Traversal vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) allows for arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical SSRF vulnerability (CVSS 7.4) enables security feature bypass.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, and denial-of-service.

items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability in OpenMage Magento
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability in OpenMage Magento LTS allows authenticated attackers to upload malicious PHP files and achieve remote code execution.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique.
